questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
options: was going
were going
would go
had gone

questions.question: Select the correct form of the verb in brackets: By the time I arrived, the meeting _____ for half an hour.
options: had started
was starting
has started
starts

questions.question: Which sentence correctly reports the principal's statement? Principal: 'We must reduce the number of exams.'
options: The principal said that we must reduce the number of exams.
The principal said that we should reduce the number of exams.
The principal said that we must have reduced the number of exams.
The principal said that we were reducing the number of exams.
questions.answer: The principal said that we must reduce the number of exams.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported speech form: 'I haven't seen him for years,' she said.
options: She said that she hadn't seen him for years.
She said that she didn't see him for years.
She said that she had not seen him for years.
She said that she didn't see him for years.
questions.answer: She said that she hadn't seen him for years.

questions.question: Which option correctly completes the sentence in reported speech? He said, 'I will phone you tomorrow.'
options: He said that he would phone me the next day.
He said that he would phone me tomorrow.
He said that he will phone me the next day.
He said that he was phoning me the next day.
questions.answer: He said that he would phone me the next day.

questions.question: Select the correct passive form: The report was written by a team of experts.
options: A team of experts wrote the report.
The report was being written by a team of experts.
The report had been written by a team of experts.
A team of experts was writing the report.
questions.answer: The report was written by a team of experts.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional? (Referring to a situation that didn't happen in the past)
options: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I had known, I would help.
If I knew, I would have helped.
If I knew, I would help.
questions.answer: If I had known, I would have helped.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: We _____ the beach if it didn't rain, but it did.
options: would have gone
would go
had gone
went

questions.question: Which option correctly reports the following: 'If I were you, I'd take that job.'?
options: He said that if he were me, he'd take that job.
He said that if he was me, he'd take that job.
He said that if he had been me, he'd take that job.
He said that if he were me, he would take that job.
questions.answer: He said that if he were me, he would take that job.

questions.question: Select the correct collocation: She's very _____ about her work.
options: enthusiastic
enthusiast
enthusiastically
enthusiasm
